name: stripe-read
description: Stripe read-only reporting — inspect your balance, charges, customers, invoices, and subscriptions via the Stripe REST API. Read-only by design: use a restricted read key (rk_...) so it can never mutate your account.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Read-only access to Stripe balance, charges, customers, invoices, and subscriptions

fields.label: Restricted API Key
fields.helpText: Use a RESTRICTED read-only key (rk_...) to limit blast radius

tools.name: stripe.get_balance
tools.description: Get the current account balance (available and pending funds by currency).

tools.name: stripe.list_charges
tools.description: List recent charges, optionally filtered by customer.

customer.description: Only return charges for this customer id (cus_...)

tools.name: stripe.list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally filtered by email.

email.description: Only return customers with this exact email address

tools.name: stripe.list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by customer and status.

customer.description: Only return invoices for this customer id (cus_...)

tools.name: stripe.list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer and status.

customer.description: Only return subscriptions for this customer id (cus_...)

status.description: Filter by subscription status (use 'all' for every status)

tools.name: stripe.get_object
tools.description: Retrieve a single object by id from an allowlisted read-only resource collection.

resource.description: The resource collection to read from

id.description: The object id (e.g. ch_..., cus_..., in_..., sub_...)
